description.value: Lion Hot Pot is a Chinese restaurant on Marine Drive in North Vancouver offering an extensive Szechuan and Cantonese-influenced menu with signature dishes including roasted fish, hot spicy pot, and roasted duck. Despite its name, the restaurant serves a broad range of stir-fries, noodle dishes, cold appetizers, and soups alongside its hot pot offerings. Online ordering with in-store pickup is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the area.
